text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S delivered "results." 
However, feeling there was still much to 
improve before the Nippon Derby, she did 
not let down her guard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crowd acknowledged her strength. 
However, there seemed to be a few people 
who took issue with her blunt attitude.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Symboli Kris S pressed forward 
toward her mission without a single glance 
aside. Very little time remained until the 
decisive Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby).
